_comment: The payoff was a second ability triggered on ON_BANISH, which is not a trigger name -- dispatch falls back to the raw string and matches nothing, so it never ran. 'Whenever THIS banishes' means the banish this card just did, so it is a CONDITIONAL in the SAME ability, reading the `banished` ref BANISH now records. No new engine event needed. The test was NOT(ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN Attack), and ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN asks about the CURRENT ATTACK, not the banished card -- so it read the attacking card's own subtypes. 'Non-attack action' is two claims: it IS an action and is NOT an attack.
